rows.note: Use 頻道 as the all-purpose choice for a broadcast or technical signal channel.

example.english: This TV channel comes in very clearly.
example.traditional: 呢個電視台嘅頻道收得好清。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 din6 si6 toi4 ge3 pan4 dou6 sau1 dak1 hou2 cing1

rows.note: Use 渠道 for a means or route through which information or something else is conveyed.

example.english: You can register through this channel.
example.traditional: 你可以透過呢個渠道報名。
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 tau3 gwo3 ni1 go3 keoi4 dou6 bou3 meng2

rows.note: Use 海峽 specifically for a narrow stretch of sea between two land masses.

example.english: The narrowest part of this channel is only a few kilometres wide.
example.traditional: 呢個海峽最窄嗰度得幾公里闊。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hoi2 haap6 zeoi3 zaak3 go2 dou6 dak1 gei2 gung1 lei5 fut3

rows.note: Use 水道 for a water channel or navigable waterway, especially when the exact river or maritime terminology is not important.

example.english: Boats can still navigate this channel at low tide.
example.traditional: 呢條水道退潮嗰陣都仲行到船。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 seoi2 dou6 teoi3 ciu4 go2 zan6 dou1 zung6 haang4 dou2 syun4
